body.generation: Based on the provided context, BMP ligands (BMP2–BMP8) mediate cell-cell communication by binding to a heteromeric complex of type I and type II receptors, such as ACVR2A, ACVR2B, and BMPR2. This interaction primarily activates the Smad signaling pathway, but can also trigger the p38 MAP kinase pathway depending on the order of receptor recruitment. Additionally, BMPs are known to crosstalk with and activate other signaling pathways, including MAP kinase, JAK-STAT, and Wnt. The text notes that while BMPR1B expression correlates with poor prognosis, specific ligand-receptor pairs beyond the general BMP-receptor complex are not detailed for other pathways in this excerpt.
